metadata.title: Biconservative hypersurfaces in space forms with harmonic curvature
metadata.abstract: A biconservative hypersurface $M$ in a space form $\overline M^{n+1}(c)$ is a hypersurface whose normal part of the vector $\Delta\vec{H}$ vanishes. We study such hypersurfaces with harmonic curvature or parallel Ricci curvature, and prove that have constant mean curvature. Also, by combining our results with previous results of H.B. Lawson Jr. and M. Umehara we obtain that if $M$ is a biconservative hypersurface in a space form $\overline M^{n+1}(c)$ with parallel Ricci tensor or harmonic curvature, then the shape operator $\bold{A}$ of $M$ is covariant constant, i.e. $\nabla\bold{A}=0$.

analysis.progressType: 附加曲率条件下的超曲面刚性
analysis.workSummary: 研究空间形式中具有调和曲率或平行 Ricci 曲率的 biconservative 超曲面，证明平均曲率常数，并结合既有分类推出形算子平行。
analysis.breakthrough: 把受约束的双保守超曲面收敛到平行第二基本形式的刚性类。
analysis.limitations: 依赖调和曲率或平行 Ricci 附加条件，不能推断所有 biconservative 超曲面均为常平均曲率。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 具体超曲面分类工具，创新范围较专门。
